svg.aria-label: Line chart of monthly cost against calls per month, from 0 to 1,500 calls, on plans published October 29, 2026, assuming 2 minutes 10 seconds of talk per call. A full-time receptionist at the US median wage plus benefits is a flat line at about $4,611 a month. Smith.ai's per-call human plans cross that line at about 596 calls a month, Moneypenny US per-minute plans at about 894, PATLive per-minute plans at about 1,453. Moneypenny's AI plan stays under $2,600 across the whole range.
svg.text: When outsourcing costs as much as a hire
Monthly cost (US$) on published plans, Oct 29, 2026. 2 min 10 s of talk per call, each provider's rounding applied.
